What EPC is.

EPC stands for Engineering, Procurement and Construction. It is a one-stop solution. IAQ designs and engineers the system, procures the equipment and materials, and carries out the installation and construction works. IAQ also makes sure the system operates as intended on completion.

Why owners choose it.
One point of contact

IAQ takes responsibility for the project, so the system works as intended.

End to end, in-house

Design through to commissioning sits with IAQ’s own team, and IAQ’s other units carry maintenance and tools hookup after it.

Cleanroom specialists

IAQ began as a cleanroom specialist, and that is still what a hi-tech facility is built around.

Local and global

IAQ delivers locally and globally, and knows the limits clients meet when they expand.

12 to 24 months

A typical EPC project runs 12 to 24 months, depending on the project.

Two contract models

EPCC for full turnkey execution. EPCM when the owner keeps direct control of the construction contracts.

Two contract models, one accountable team.
